evidenceClass: deterministic simulated capacity; not live-provider traffic

scenarios.name: midrunExpiry
checks: midrun-expiry: fresh-in-window QUALIFIED evidence steers coder picks to the measured route
midrun-expiry: crossing the 30d boundary reads the verdict as expired (undefined status)
midrun-expiry: expired evidence stops contributing ranking score but never quarantines the route
midrun-expiry: expired TOOL_AGENT verdict does not leak into EXPLORER inheritance
midrun-expiry: expired route still serves work (no quarantine, no starvation)
midrun-expiry: zero leaked reservations

scenarios.name: requalification
checks: requalification: current HARD_FAILURE receipt excludes the route from coder work
requalification: expired HARD_FAILURE reverts to legacy eligibility (never permanent quarantine)
requalification: stale route flags needsRequalification so the bounded suite retests it
requalification: fresh receipt restores QUALIFIED status on the next decision
requalification: requalified route competes again and wins on measured evidence
requalification: zero leaked reservations

scenarios.name: suiteVersion
checks: suite-version: supported suite reads its verdicts
suite-version: receiptSuiteSupported distinguishes current vs incompatible producers
suite-version: fresh-but-incompatible receipt exposes no verdict (unreadable, not trusted)
suite-version: incompatible receipt does NOT permanently exclude — legacy eligibility
suite-version: incompatible receipt flags requalification with an explicit reason code
suite-version: unsupported-suite 'QUALIFIED' lends no ordering trust — supported route wins
suite-version: requalification under the current suite reopens the route's verdicts

scenarios.name: roleSwap
checks: role-swap: pre-swap coder picks land on the qualified route
role-swap: the very next coder decision respects the fresh NOT_QUALIFIED verdict
role-swap: unaffected roles keep their verdicts — reviewer still lands on the qualified route
role-swap: zero leaked reservations

scenarios.name: healthVsQualification
checks: health-vs-qual: injected 429 burst parks the QUALIFIED route
health-vs-qual: parked qualified route is not served — admission falls to the unmeasured route, never the HARD_FAILURE route
health-vs-qual: the disqualified route is never a candidate regardless of perfect health
health-vs-qual: recovered qualified route re-enters and wins on the next decide
health-vs-qual: zero leaked reservations

drift-scale: zero role-ineligible selections while evidence churned
drift-scale: zero starvation
drift-scale: zero false waits
drift-scale: zero leaked reservations
